correctness.rationale: The basepoint-free parametrization is birational and the only differential ramification is t=0. Local charts give an A4 cusp at [-1:1:0], a transverse node at the two preimages t=+/-i of [1:0:0], and a smooth infinity. The remaining pairs must differ by nontrivial fifth-root multiplication. Their four explicit cubics are all separable (absolute cyclotomic discriminant norm 674041) and pairwise coprime (six absolute resultant norms 2000), and denominators do not vanish, so they give exactly 12 transverse distinct nodes. Total delta 13+2=15 exhausts septic genus. Plucker gives dual degree 11; the tangent-line map is computed directly. Exact standalone standard-library verifier rerun from its actual final path.
